summary: Helena NF lookout NE of Helena, MT: L-4 cab 1936, present R-6 cab 1961; NHLR-registered 2022; 2018 Forest Service disposal notice and 2024 threat report; manned in summer per recreation.gov.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab atop a 10-foot concrete base (built 1961); first lookout had an L-4 cab (1936)
facts.status_note: A 2018 Forest Service disposal project called the lookout excess; a 2024 chapter report says it seems to be the primary lookout threatened. The sources read do not confirm removal or a final decision.

staffing.status: conflicting: manned mid-June through September per the recreation.gov cabin listing; may be staffed in summer per NHLR; available for emergencies per firelookout.com; the 2018 project says it had not been used in several years

access.note: Reached by passenger vehicle per the nearby cabin's recreation.gov listing, which says the lookout is manned mid-June through September. Whether the cab is open to visitors is not stated. Level is my judgment.

notes_for_editor: Fact-check 2026-10-08: the story no longer says Indian Flats Cabin is rentable; its Recreation.gov page says it does not offer reservations there. Status is unsettled. The 2018 disposal notice says the lookout was excess; the recreation.gov listing (undated) says it is manned mid-June through September; the 2024 chapter report says it seems to be the primary lookout threatened. Not read, due to budget: a May 2021 Hogback Lookout Restoration NEPA document and a 2023 FFLA chapter report, both seen only in search snippets. The 2021 document may show whether the 2018 disposal went ahead or was replaced by restoration; it should be checked before publishing a status. Budget note: this tower used 3 WebSearch calls (one over the 2-call budget) and 6 page reads. Record's elevation 2380.2 m matches the NHLR figure. No corrections proposed.
